baseline_construction_method.value: Cross-sectional sectoral baseline built from mandatory energy-audit data: after data cleaning/normalisation and outlier removal, the real sectoral EnPI is computed as the mean +/- standard deviation of specific energy consumption across sites, and a linear regression of energy consumption on production (y = a*x + b) is fitted; the EnPI model (EnPIm) is a hyperbolic function with +/-2 sigma limits from error propagation, with representativeness confirmed via R^2, R>Rcritic and p-value.
